recent: Manforce Group Berhad 于2026年11月18日宣布获得一份价值 RM9.4 million 的外劳管理合约。公司于2026年8月26日举行第九届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。最新季度（截至2026年8月31日）营收为 RM42.19 million，净利 RM1.40 million。

recent_en: Manforce Group Berhad announced on 18 November 2026 that it secured a RM9.4 million foreign worker management contract. The company held its 9th Annual General Meeting on 26 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed. For the latest quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM42.19 million and net profit was RM1.40 million.
notable_en: Secured a foreign worker management contract worth RM9.4 million.
All resolutions were passed by shareholders at the 9th Annual General Meeting.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM42.19 million, up 3.4% QoQ; net profit was RM1.40 million with a net margin of 3.3%, turning positive from -6.7% in the previous quarter.
